Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und kaufmännisches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, aus Daten klare Prioritäten und messbare Verbesserungen abzuleiten. Erfahrung oder nachweisbares Potenzial in Digital Product Management, Growth, Conversion-Rate-Optimierung (CRO), Growth Design oder E-Commerce. Sehr gutes Verständnis von UX/UI-Prinzipien und ein ausgeprägtes ästhetisches Gespür für intuitive, ansprechende digitale Erlebnisse. Talent für klare, überzeugende Website-Texte und kommerzielle Botschaften, einschließlich Headlines, USPs und CTAs. Unternehmerisches Denken, ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Initiative zu ergreifen und Ideen bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben. Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools als fester Bestandteil deines Arbeitsalltags, um Produktivität und Problemlösung zu verbessern. Starke Problemlösungskompetenz, Neugier und die Bereitschaft, zu experimentieren, zu lernen und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Warum wir? Ein internationales und unternehmerisches Umfeld: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen in Berlin, Breslau und Helsingborg zusammen. Echte Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hast direkten Einfluss auf das digitale Kundenerlebnis, die Conversion-Rates und das Unternehmenswachstum. Eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der Entwicklung: Du ergreifst Initiative, gestaltest Ideen und wächst gemeinsam mit einem kollegialen, ambitionierten Team. Ambitioniertes Wachstum auf starkem Fundament: Du wirst Teil eines etablierten, gründergeführten Unternehmens, das auf langfristiges Wachstum, Qualität und den Aufbau einer skalierbaren Organisation setzt. title: Agentic AI Principal (m/f/d)
description: <div class="description content"> <p>We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.</p> <p>Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.</p> <p>The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.</p> <p>Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.</p> <p>This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <p><strong>Shaping and winning</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Agentic AI advisory and strategy:</strong> shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.</li> <li>Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.</li> <li>Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.</li> <li>Lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentisation, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.</li> <li>Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Designing and building</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design and build engineering:</strong> set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.</li> <li>Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.</li> <li>Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.</li> <li>Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.</li> <li>Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.</li> <li>Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.</li> <li>Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Governance and safeguards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.</li> <li>Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.</li> <li>Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.</li> <li>Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Principal-level leadership and growing capability&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.</li> <li>Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.</li> <li>Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.</li> <li>Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.</li> <li>Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).</li> <li>Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.</li> <li>Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.</li> <li>Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).</li> <li>Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.</li> <li>Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.</li> <li><strong>Strongly preferred: </strong>delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&amp;D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial).</li> <li>Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.</li> </ul> </div> <h3>Consulting and Commercial Track Record</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.</li> <li>Strong consulting and commercial judgement: you can point to data and AI (ideally agentic or GenAI) pursuits you helped shape, sell and deliver in the raw.title: CRM & Marketing Intelligence Manager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Für den Maschinenraum suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen

CRM & Marketing Intelligence Manager (m/w/d) mit einer starken Analysefähigkeit für Daten und der Entwicklung sowie Umsetzung von konkreten Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Engagement und Loyalität unserer Mitgliedsunternehmen.

Über den Maschinenraum

Der Maschinenraum ist das geteilte Innovationsökosystem deutscher Mittelstands- und Familienunternehmen, um gemeinsam Zukunftsthemen besser zu verstehen und mutiger zu gestalten. Gemeinsam mit rund 80 Mitgliedsunternehmen – darunter Fiege, Sennheiser, Vorwerk und Viessmann – bietet der Maschinenraum Formate und Strukturen, um Transformation systematisch anzugehen: durch den Austausch von Erfahrungen, den Aufbau von Kompetenzen und die Entwicklung konkreter Lösungen. Das Team aus rund 40 Mitarbeitenden betreut die Mitgliedsunternehmen, entwickelt Trainings- und Beratungsformate und betreibt einen Co-Innovation-Space im Herzen Berlins.

Als CRM & Marketing Intelligence Manager (m/w/d) bist du die datengetriebene Kraft hinter unserer Mitgliederkommunikation. Du analysierst, wie sich unsere Mitglieder verhalten – welche Formate sie nutzen, wo sie aktiv sind und wo sie abspringen – und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse in gezielte Maßnahmen, die Engagement und Bindung stärken. Du konzipierst zusätzlich Strategien zur Identifizierung und Ansprache von neuen Zielgruppen und Kontaktpersonen im Netzwerk.

Was du bewirkst

  • CRM-Management & Datenstruktur
    Du verantwortest die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer CRM-Struktur in Salesforce und stellst sicher, dass Daten vollständig, aktuell und auswertbar sind. Du baust ein KPI-Framework auf, das dem Team eine datenbasierte Steuerung ermöglicht und erstellst regelmäßige Reportings, aus denen du Optimierungsmaßnahmen ableitest.
  • Zielgruppen- & Verhaltensanalyse
    Du analysierst das Verhalten unserer Mitglieder systematisch – auf Basis von CRM- und Analytics-Daten – und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis dafür, was verschiedene Zielgruppen antreibt und was sie zurückhält. Du bist verantwortlich für die Segmentierung unserer bestehenden Mitgliederbasis und erstellst Strategien für und mit unseren Teams, wie sie diese zielführend identifizieren und ansprechen.
  • Growth & Retention Maßnahmen
    Auf Basis deiner Analysen entwickelst und steuerst du gezielte Handlungen sowie automatisierte Marketingmaßnahmen zur Steigerung von Awareness, Engagement und Loyalität. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit den anderen Teams des Maschinenraum zusammen und unterstützt sie mit Handlungsempfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung sowie Vermarktung von Angeboten.

Stellenanforderungen

Das bist du

  • Du denkst in Daten, aber handelst in Maßnahmen. Du weißt, dass Zahlen allein nichts verändern – und verstehst es, Insights in überzeugende Empfehlungen und konkrete Umsetzung zu übersetzen.
  • Du bringst 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im CRM, Growth Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle mit – idealerweise in einem B2B-Umfeld, einem E-Commerce oder einer mitgliederbasierten Organisation.
  • Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Zielgruppensegmentierung und Verhaltensanalyse sowie in der Ableitung konkreter Kommunikations- und Marketingmaßnahmen.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Salesforce (Sales/Marketing Cloud) – alternativ bringst du tiefes Know-how in vergleichbaren B2B-CRMs (z. B. HubSpot) mit und hast keine Scheu vor Salesforce
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit relevanten KI-Tools in den Bereichen Analyse und Marketing Automation mit.
  • Du denkst strukturiert, arbeitest präzise und kannst komplexe Datenzusammenhänge klar und verständlich kommunizieren.
  • Du bist eigeninitiativ und verlierst dich nicht in der Analyse – du willst Dinge bewegen.
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau ist Voraussetzung; gute Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Was dich erwartet

  • Verantwortung & Freiraum: Die Möglichkeit, datenbasiertes Marketing in einer der spannendsten Netzwerkorganisationen im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand von Grund auf aufzubauen.
  • Teamwork: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Member Success und Kommunikationsteam.
  • Hybrid Work: Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer ausgewogenen Mischung aus Präsenz in unserem Büro und der Möglichkeit, nach Bedarf mobil zu arbeiten
  • Arbeitsplatz & Lage: Ein moderner Space im Herzen Berlins mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung
  • Impact & Ökosystem: Ein purpose-getriebenes Unternehmen mit einer klaren Vision und einer inspirierenden Community aus Mittelstand, Start-ups und VCs
  • Teamkultur: Eine wertschätzende Feedback-Kultur mit Mut zu neuen Ideen, regelmäßigen Teamevents (z.B. Sommerfest & Offsite), Teamtrainings und echtem Raum für persönliches Wachstum
  • Benefits & Auszeit: 30 Urlaubstage, freie Brückentage sowie attraktive Corporate Benefits (z. B. Urban Sports Club, BVG, Aware by Aeon)

title: Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d)
description: Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.   Als Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d) bei FlixTrain verantwortest du die Technologie, die bestimmt, wie unsere Fahrgäste an Bord verbunden sind, navigieren und jede Reise erleben - von WLAN und Netzwerk-Infrastruktur über On-Board-Units bis hin zu mobilen Endgeräten für unser Zugpersonal. In einer Bahnwelt, in der Konnektivität zum entscheidenden Differenzierungsmerkmal wird und Technologien wie Starlink neu definieren, was möglich ist, prägst du unmittelbar, wie FlixTrain vorne bleibt und weiterhin hochwertige, unvergessliche Reisen bietet.   Als Teil des Product-Development-Teams im Bereich Rolling-Stock & Maintenance sorgst du dafür, dass unsere On-Board-Hardware ein herausragendes Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste, einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine gute Arbeitsumgebung für unser Zugpersonal ermöglicht. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie FlixTrain im Wettbewerb um Konnektivität an Bord die Nase vorn behält und verlässliche, hochwertige Reiseerlebnisse liefert. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Operations, Customer Product und FlixTech sowie mit externen Partnern wie Talgo, ECMs und Lieferanten (z. B. Icomera, Advantech) zusammen. raw.description:

Als Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d) bei FlixTrain verantwortest du die Technologie, die bestimmt, wie unsere Fahrgäste an Bord verbunden sind, navigieren und jede Reise erleben - von WLAN und Netzwerk-Infrastruktur über On-Board-Units bis hin zu mobilen Endgeräten für unser Zugpersonal. title: Account Manager II (German Speaking)
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success. What you’ll be doing As an Account Manager, you will: Identify and close opportunities within your book of business to grow accounts through upsells, new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned to evolving customer needs. Build deep relationships with key stakeholders to understand their strategic initiatives, and uncover whitespace opportunities. Use MEDDICC (or similar) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to ensure forecast accuracy and deal velocity. Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows that drive stronger adoption and platform value for upsells. Create custom proposals and business cases that quantify value, align with commercial goals, and support customer budgeting cycles. Work across senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders to land multi-threaded expansions. Lead commercial conversations ensuring terms reflect the value Pleo delivers. Use customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and deepen platform adoption. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC) A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention Complete fluency in English Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need. You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal. You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value. This role is not a good fit for you if: You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue. You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it. You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment. Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap. Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale The location [Delete this for critical/hard to fill role where VISA sponsorship can be an option] Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits! 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role Bar Raiser : A final interview with a senior leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You'll join the global Salesforce team for 12 months to make the CRM faster, clearer and more intuitive.

This is a hands-on build role. You'll design the experience and code it in Lightning Web Components, working with Sales, RevOps, Marketing and Data, and directly with the reps who use the result.


What You Will Do


Redesign the rep experience

  • Audit the current Lightning experience (record pages, console apps, list views, home pages) and find where reps lose time to clicks, clutter and missing context.

  • Turn what you find into a prioritised roadmap of UI improvements tied to rep productivity and adoption.

  • Design and prototype improved layouts, workflows and components, and validate them with reps before building.

Build with LWC

  • Develop custom Lightning Web Components (and supporting Apex where needed) that replace clunky standard layouts with focused, usable interfaces.

  • Configure and extend Lightning App Builder pages, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic Actions and console apps to deliver a consistent experience across teams and regions.

  • Build reusable components and follow SLDS conventions so the UI stays consistent and maintainable after your contract ends.

Make it stick

  • Run feedback sessions, usability tests and pilots with reps and managers, and iterate on the results.

  • Track adoption, page performance and user satisfaction to show what each release changed.

  • Create release notes, short walkthroughs and handover documentation so changes land well and the team can maintain what you build.

Work as part of the global team

  • Work within the global team's standards for source control, code review, sandboxes and release management.

  • Partner with admins, architects and data teams so UI changes fit the wider data model, security model and automation.

  • Pass on what you learn about Lightning UX patterns and LWC best practices to the wider team.


What You Will Need


Must have

  • Strong, demonstrable experience building Lightning Web Components in production.

  • Solid Apex, SOQL and Salesforce data model knowledge to support your components.

  • Deep knowledge of Lightning Experience customisation: App Builder, Dynamic Forms, page layouts, console apps and Flows.

  • Experience with Salesforce DX, Git and a CI/CD or deployment process.

  • A UX mindset: you start from user problems, can explain design decisions, and can take feedback from non-technical users.

  • Clear communication and the ability to work independently across time zones in a global team.

Nice to have

  • Portfolio or examples of Salesforce UI work you've shipped (screenshots or demos are ideal).

  • Experience with SLDS, Figma or similar prototyping tools, and accessibility (WCAG) principles.

  • Experience in Sales Cloud, especially rep-facing workflows such as opportunity management, account planning and pipeline views.

  • Jest testing for LWC, and Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Platform App Builder).

  • Experience with performance profiling and optimisation in Lightning pages.


What Success Looks Like (12 Months)

  • Month 3: UX audit complete and a prioritised roadmap agreed with Sales leadership.

  • Month 6: First wave of redesigned pages and components live for a pilot group, with adoption and feedback baselined.

  • Month 12: Redesigned experience rolled out to target teams, a maintained component library in place, and full documentation handed to the global team.

What we offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Vom Workout bis zur Wellness-Auszeit - du entscheidest, wie du dich fit hältst. Mit Urban Sports Club oder Wellpass hast du die Wahl. Yay! Du hast es bis hierher geschafft! Wenn du jetzt immer noch liest, ist die Wahrscheinlichkeit groß, dass wir ein Match sind. Eine Sache liegt uns aber noch auf dem Herzen: Trau dich! Vor allem als Frau, oder als jemand einer unterrepräsentierten Bevölkerungsgruppe. Auch wenn du nicht überall einen Haken setzen kannst, möchten wir dich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. title: Solutions Architect
description: About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. raw.title: Solutions Architect
raw.description:
About Plane

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

 

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

 

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

 

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

 

Humans and agents

We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.

 

Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.

 

This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

 

About the role

Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call.

 

What you'll do

  • Own the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work.

  • Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist.

  • Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one.

  • Define the migration path when a customer moves off two or three existing tools at once, including what data does not survive the move and saying so up front.

  • Work daily with sales on live deals and with engineering when a customer's requirements expose a real gap in the product, carrying that gap back as a specific, scoped request rather than a vague one.

  • Answer the same security questionnaire in a slightly different format for the fourth time this month, because every regulated buyer's procurement process is its own small bureaucracy and none of them read each other's paperwork.

 

What you'll bring

  • You have designed and defended a technical architecture to a skeptical buyer, and you can walk us through one deal where the customer's own security or infrastructure team changed your design.

  • You understand self-hosted and on-premises deployment beyond a docker-compose file, including networking, SSO and identity federation, and what changes when a customer runs the software instead of you.

  • You can read a security questionnaire or compliance requirement and translate it into an actual deployment decision, not a reassurance.

  • You are comfortable being the technical voice on a sales call, including the parts where the answer is no or not yet.

  • You write technical documentation a customer's own engineers will actually follow, because you will not be in the room when they run it.

 

Nice to haves

  • You have worked pre-sales or post-sales in a solutions architecture, sales engineering, or technical account management role selling to regulated industries.

  • You have contributed to Plane, run it self-hosted, or maintained another open project people rely on.

  • You have shipped or supported deployments into banking, defense, healthcare, or air-gapped environments specifically.

  • You have opinions about how AI agents should be permissioned and audited in an enterprise environment, and can defend them.

 

Tech

  • Backend: Python/Django, Golang, Node.js, Postgres, Redis

  • Messaging: RabbitMQ, Kafka

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Rancher, self-hosted deployment via Docker and Helm

  • Identity: SAML, OIDC, SCIM

  • Everyday tools: GitHub, Plane (yes, we run on it), Figma, Slack

Why Plane?

Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead.

 

The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both.

 

The constraints make you better. Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer.

 

The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production. We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role.

 

Your name is on the work. The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you.

 

Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Du arbeitest eigenständig, zuverlässig und pragmatisch und hast eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität. Du lernst schnell, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest verstehen, wie unterschiedliche Bereiche eines Unternehmens zusammenspielen. title: Freelance Senior AI Platform Expert - Azure Databricks
description: Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale. We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain. We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core. Role We are looking for an experienced freelancer to advise and support our internal platform team in designing, building and improving an AI platform on Azure Databricks. The role is internal only, with no client-facing responsibilities. The freelancer will act as a senior technical reference for the team, helping shape the architecture, establish engineering standards, review technical implementations and support the team in building and operating a reliable, scalable and secure platform. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on technical expertise with the ability to mentor engineers and transfer knowledge. The freelancer will support the team across the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the platform, including: Defining and reviewing the target architecture on Azure Databricks, covering workspaces, environments (dev/test/prod), Unity Catalog, security, networking and integration with Azure services. Advising on CI/CD/CT pipelines for code, data and models, including automated testing, promotion across environments, model registry workflows and continuous training triggered by schedules, drift or new data. Reviewing architecture decisions, code, Terraform configurations and pipeline implementations, providing actionable recommendations and identifying areas for improvement. Defining reusable MLOps standards, templates and engineering best practices. Supporting platform reliability, scalability, governance, security and operational excellence. Contributing hands-on when needed to unblock the team, troubleshoot technical challenges or develop reference implementations. Coaching team members, facilitating design and code reviews, and transferring knowledge to help the team become increasingly autonomous. Requirements Extensive experience in data engineering, ML engineering, platform engineering or MLOps, ideally with at least 8 years of relevant experience. Strong practical experience with Azure Databricks in production environments, ideally at least 3 years. Solid knowledge of MLOps and the Databricks ecosystem, including MLflow, model registry, Model Serving, Feature Engineering, Databricks Workflows and monitoring. Experience designing and implementing CI/CD/CT pipelines, ideally using GitLab, and infrastructure-as-code practices. Hands-on experience with Terraform and cloud infrastructure, ideally using the Databricks and Azure providers. Solid knowledge of Azure services, including ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Entra ID and cloud networking (VNet injection, private endpoints). Strong Python and PySpark skills, alongside software engineering best practices such as testing, packaging and code quality. Experience with Unity Catalog, including data governance, lineage and access control. Proven ability to mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and establish technical standards. Experience with GenAI/LLMOps on Databricks, including technologies such as Vector Search, Mosaic AI Agent Framework and AI Gateway, is a strong plus. raw.description:
About PAICON

PAICON is a Heidelberg-based health data intelligence company building the global health data foundation through its PaiX ecosystem, working to close the representation gap in medical data so personalised medicine works for everyone. We harmonise ethically approved, GDPR compliant real-world health data from providers around the world into a global dataset. The data covers multiple modalities on various disease entities. Our flagship product, PaiX Navigator, generates actionable insights for pharma, biotech and AI companies worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on data engineer to integrate data from our global partners into our platform. Data integration is the core of the role, and agentic AI tooling is part of how we do it. This is an on-site position in our Heidelberg office.

You will work closely with medical, engineering and commercialization colleagues in a small, pragmatic team with short decision paths and direct access to the founders.

What you'll do

  • Onboard new data partners, from first assessment of their data through to reliable production ingestion

  • Map partner data to our internal data model and work with providers to close gaps

  • Build and maintain robust, well-tested data pipelines

  • Ensure high standards in data quality and help evolve our database and data infrastructure

  • Document data and transformations so that every step is transparent and traceable

  • Ensure data is handled securely, de-identified and in line with healthcare data regulations

  • Help us apply AI-assisted methods to data integration, with appropriate quality checks

What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on data engineering, including building and running production data pipelines

  • Strong SQL and relational database design skills

  • R and Python skills on Linux systems

  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7 FHIR and common clinical coding systems

  • Understanding of data privacy and security in a regulated environment, including GDPR

  • Day-to-day use of AI-assisted development tools and curiosity to go further with them

  • A pragmatic mindset: you choose the simplest solution that works

  • Ability to turn messy, real-world data into clear findings and next steps

  • Good communication with technical and non-technical colleagues

  • Independent, hands-on working style with agile mindset

  • Fluent English, our primary working language

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with genomics/clinical & pathology data/digital histopathology data

  • Experience with graph databases or ontologies

  • Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure on hyperscalers.

What you get from joining PAICON

  • Hybrid working, with core office days to help organise how you do your best work

  • An inclusive team where different backgrounds and perspectives are part of the point

  • A friendly, motivated and agile environment where things move quickly and you see the impact of your work

  • Flat hierarchies and short decision paths, with direct access to founders and medical, engineering and commercial colleagues

  • Real ownership of your ideas: propose something good and you will be the one building it

You will join a team solving a problem that matters, in a company where your voice carries weight from day one. There are no long approval chains between a good idea and a production system, and no layers between you and the people who depend on the data you integrate. If you want to shape how global health data is built rather than inherit someone else’s architecture, this is the place to do it! Cheers!

Ein gutes Verständnis für betriebliche ERP-Prozesse und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen technisch einzuordnen. Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und die Bereitschaft, Probleme bis zur Lösung nachzuverfolgen. Teamgeist, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine klare, freundliche Kommunikation mit Kunden und Kollegen. Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau in Wort und Schrift. Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort in Köln sowie zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen zu unseren Kunden . Zusätzliche Kenntnisse, die uns freuen Erfahrung mit Upgrades oder Migrationen von Dynamics NAV zu Business Central. Kenntnisse in AL für Business Central oder C/AL für ältere NAV-Umgebungen . Erfahrung mit SQL Server und der Analyse lokaler NAV-/ERP-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in PowerShell, Power Automate oder Power BI. Erfahrung mit ERP-Schnittstellen, Webservices und APIs. Was dich bei uns erwartet Eine Aufgabe mit direktem Kundenkontakt, technischen Fragestellungen und Einblicken in unterschiedliche Geschäftsprozesse. Du arbeitest mit unserem IT-Team zusammen und bringst dein Wissen in die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der Kundenumgebungen ein. Interesse? consulting.</li> <li>Experience working with cross-functional teams, including developers, architects, data teams, project managers, technical project managers, marketing operations, and account teams.</li> <li>Knowledge of data usage within campaign execution, including audience selection, validation, segmentation, QA, and data-driven campaign logic.</li> <li>Relevant platform certifications description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.</strong><br><strong>&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>Our people are the key to our success. We work with our agencies and clients to build data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster and at scale</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who we are looking for:</strong></span></p> <p style="text-align: left;">We are looking for a Product professional to lead the evolution of Work Management capabilities within WPP Open, WPP's AI-powered platform.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">The candidate will have experience building or managing enterprise work management, project management and workflow automation. You will understand how large organizations plan, assign, execute, approve and measure work at scale, and how technology can remove friction from these processes.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">Leveraging this expertise, you will closely collaborate with the broader product leadership team to ensure that strategy effectively aligns with and advances our overarching vision across the entire product portfolio and to provide our agencies and their clients with a competitive advantage through the application of data and technology.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">This role requires a person who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, helping shape how work gets done across WPP while ensuring Open can integrate seamlessly into the workflows our clients use.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></span></p> <ul style="text-align: left;"> <li>Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Work Management capabilities within WPP Open, ensuring alignment with the broader Open platform strategy and business objectives.</li> <li>Partner with Product Leadership to shape a product roadmap, emphasizing value realization through lean and iterative methodologies.</li> <li>Work closely with Engineering, Design, UX to deliver a connected Work Management vision spanning briefing, project execution, approvals, and operational reporting. Set clear objectives with teams and ensure alignment of plans and workstreams to achieve them.</li> <li>Design solutions that connect work across teams and agents, reducing handoffs and improving visibility from brief to outcome.</li> <li>Define product requirements for integrations with leading work management and collaboration platforms, understanding thier roadmaps to implement capabilities in close synchronisation</li> <li>Provide day-to-day vision, direction and motivation to the cross-functional product team, including product management, data analysts, engineers and product enablement.</li> <li>Utilize data to drive product strategies and plans, gathering quantitative and qualitative feedback from users and stakeholders to enhance product adoption and usage continually.</li> <li>Promote best practices of Product Management and Ownership throughout the team, identifying and implementing areas for improvement. Offer guidance and coaching to Product Managers and Product Owners to elevate processes, tools, and ways of working.</li> <li>Support development teams through definition of requirements, product reviews, user acceptance testing, and sign-off against requirements and specifications.</li> <li>Act as the voice of the customer by balancing platform priorities with the needs of agencies, operations teams and clients. Keep them up to date with strategic direction and the product roadmap, and communicate new product releases to ensure successful advocacy and adoption.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: left;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you'll need:</strong></span></p> <ul style="text-align: left;"> <li>Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles.</li> <li>Proven track record delivering enterprise SaaS products, workflow platforms, work management solutions, or operational systems.</li> <li>Understanding of Project and task management, Workflow analysis, transformation and automation, Approval workflows, Agency best practice operations and delivery processes</li> <li>Direct experience with working with work management platforms and understand how these tools are deployed and integrated within agencies, enterprises, and client organizations.</li> <li>Proficiency in leading and implementing agile development frameworks for delivering technical products, coupled with experience collaborating with cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience delivering products that integrate with third-party enterprise systems. Understanding of APIs, system integrations, workflow orchestration and data interoperability.</li> <li>Experience working with enterprise clients that require integration with proprietary or client-specific systems.</li> <li>Familiar with AI-enabled workflow automation and agentic systems.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: left;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who you are:</strong></span></p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>You're open<em>:</em> </strong>We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>You're optimistic<em>:</em></strong> <span id="628d56ad5d8a35dab853e65d9daa237c" class="editor-module-hl-green-solid">We believe</span> in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>You're extraordinary:</strong> we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What we'll give you:</strong></span></p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Passionate, inspired people</strong> – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Scale and opportunity</strong> – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Challenging and stimulating work</strong> – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?</p> <p style="text-align: left;"><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</strong></p> <p><strong>WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. title: Senior Manager, HR Process Excellence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at <a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a commercially minded&nbsp;<strong>Senior Manager, HR Process Excellence</strong> to drive the design, optimisation and continuous improvement of HR processes across Verve Group.&nbsp;</p> <p>As the subject matter expert (SME) for HR process excellence, you will partner with HR leadership and leaders across the organisation. You will be identifying opportunities to improve the effectiveness of HR processes across the employee lifecycle. Key principles are simplicity and scalability as we embark on the next exciting stage of growth.</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><em>This is a temp-to-perm role offering a hybrid working arrangement, with three days per week in our London office in Covent Garden.</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>HR Process Excellence &amp; Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the organisation's subject matter expert for HR process excellence, providing specialist guidance and thought leadership across a broad range of HR initiatives.</li> <li>Lead the end-to-end assessment, design, redesign and optimisation of HR processes across the employee lifecycle.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to eliminate inefficiencies, reduce complexity, remove duplication and improve process effectiveness, quality and user experience.</li> <li>Challenge legacy processes and existing ways of working, driving a culture of simplification and scalability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Delivery of HR Improvement Initiatives</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and support multiple process improvement initiatives across HR, working across a portfolio of priorities that may include recruitment, onboarding, employee lifecycle management, HR operations, performance management, talent, reward and employee offboarding.</li> <li>Develop business cases, quantify benefits and define measurable success criteria for proposed improvements.</li> <li>Oversee implementation of agreed process changes, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable and simple!&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Engagement &amp; Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships across the business.&nbsp;</li> <li>Act as a trusted adviser to senior stakeholders, providing expert recommendations on process design and improvement opportunities.</li> <li>Balance commercial impact with legal risk and bring together internal stakeholders to align on a path forward.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>HR Technology, Data &amp; Automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with HR Ops and Intelligence teams to identify opportunities for automation, workflow optimisation, self-service and improved use of HR systems.</li> <li>Ensure process improvements are designed with technology enablement and automation at their core.&nbsp;</li> <li>Promote data-driven decision-making and the use of digital solutions to improve HR service across the entire employee experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Change Management &amp; Capability Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the adoption of redesigned processes through effective stakeholder engagement, communications, training and change management.</li> <li>Equip HR teams and process owners with the tools, frameworks and knowledge required to sustain improvements independently.</li> <li>Share best practices, lessons learned and reusable process improvement approaches across HR.</li> <li>Champion a continuous improvement mindset, encouraging teams to challenge existing practices and take ownership of operational effectiveness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll need:</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience in HR process improvement, change management/transformation. Ideally a consultancy background, either internal or external.&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrable experience leading end-to-end process improvement initiatives within a global, rapidly growing organisation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of HR processes across multiple areas of the employee lifecycle.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously, from initial assessment and solution design through to implementation and benefits realisation.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to engage and challenge senior leaders.</li> <li>Demonstrable ability to lead change, influence adoption and embed sustainable improvements across teams.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of process excellence methodologies this could include but not limited to Lean, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret operational data, establish baselines and measure improvement outcomes.</li> <li>Understanding of HR technology, workflow automation, digital self-service and the role of technology in enabling process transformation.</li> <li>Exceptional communication, facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Stay healthy with our<strong> Bupa HealthCare Plan</strong> with easy access to medical care</li> <li>Support your long-term financial security with our <strong>Aviva Corporate Pension Scheme</strong>, with Verve contributing 3% of your qualifying earnings</li> <li>Pick what matters most to you in our <strong>Personalized Benefits Platform, </strong>with a budget of<strong>&nbsp; </strong>£50/month</li> <li>Recharge with <strong>25 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days </strong>throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays</li> </ul> <p><strong>Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget &amp; internal webinars</strong>… and even more reasons to join us!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.&nbsp;<br><br>If you are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, <a href="https://verve.com/california-applicant-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">click here</a> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.<br></span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">If you are located in the EU or UK visit our&nbsp;</span><a style="font-size: 8pt;" href="https://verve.com/applicant-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a><span style="font-size: 8pt;"> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.</p> <p>The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated UK enterprise environments, including financial services and telecommunications.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li><strong>Agentic AI Advisory &amp; Strategy: </strong>Shape and solution complex UKI pursuits, working with account, commercial and delivery leaders to translate client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.</li> patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks’ agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.</li> <li>Design solutions appropriate for regulated UK environments, including financial services and telecommunications, with strong consideration of data sovereignty, privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, maintaining sufficient hands-on involvement to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.</li> <li>Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.</li> <li>Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and
