title: Senior Technical Program Manager, International Security & Privacy Compliance
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="http://www.coreweave.com/">www.coreweave.com</a>.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>CoreWeave is taking its AI cloud and data center services to new countries. Each new market brings its own data protection, cybersecurity, and data residency requirements, and we have to meet them before we launch.</p> <p>As the Technical Program Manager for International Security &amp; Privacy Compliance, you will own the program that gets CoreWeave compliant in each new market. You will turn local legal and regulatory requirements into controls, timelines, and owners. Then you will lead Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Center Operations, Product, and Go-to-Market through to a compliant launch. The problem is defined; the solution is not. You will build the playbook as you go and make it repeatable for each market that follows.</p> <p>The role is based in London so you can work during business hours with US teams and with teams in the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end compliance program for new-country launches, from early regulatory assessment through go-live and ongoing upkeep.</li> <li>Work with Legal and Privacy counsel to turn local laws into concrete technical and operational requirements. These cover data protection and privacy, cybersecurity, data localization and residency, cross-border data transfer, incident reporting, and registration or licensing. Legal owns the interpretation; you own turning it into delivery.</li> <li>Map country requirements to CoreWeave's existing control framework (SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, and related certifications). Find gaps and drive the work to close them with control owners in Security, Engineering, and Data Center Operations.</li> <li>Build and maintain source-of-truth program plans, a requirements register, and a dependency map for each market. Use them to drive high-quality execution against timelines leadership can rely on.</li> <li>Build country-specific incident and breach notification obligations into CoreWeave's incident response process before go-live.</li> <li>Find risks and blockers early, such as data residency limits on architecture, local vendor or partner obligations, and regulator timelines. Drive them to resolution across teams, or escalate them with clear options and tradeoffs.</li> <li>Coordinate privacy reviews and data protection impact assessments for in-country services, working with Privacy and Product.</li> <li>Bring compliance requirements into product and data center launch plans early, so customer-facing commitments, contracts, and Trust Center content reflect what we can actually deliver.</li> <li>Report program status, risk, and decisions needed to Security, Legal, and business leadership.</li> <li>Make the work repeatable. Turn each market's lessons into a scalable country-entry playbook, templates, and workflows in Jira and our GRC tooling.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>[5+] years of relevant experience in international security and privacy compliance program management, GRC, or related technical program management, preferably at a cloud, data center, or infrastructure provider.</li> <li>A track record of managing end-to-end, large-scale, cross-functional programs with significant organizational impact under little or no supervision. You are comfortable with work that has a defined problem but no defined solution.</li> <li>Strong execution skills. You get things done to high quality on timelines people can trust.</li> <li>You identify risks and blockers early and drive them to resolution.</li> <li>A solid grounding in industry best practices and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR-style data protection regimes. You can make well-reasoned decisions and tradeoffs that fit CoreWeave's context.</li> <li>You quickly learn and keep up with the requirements of unfamiliar jurisdictions, well enough to take an active part in decisions with Legal, Security, and Engineering.</li> <li>You use feedback to shape priorities, and you make sure compliance solutions don't degrade the customer experience.</li> <li>You influence cross-functional decisions with a structured approach, data, and technical insight, to achieve the intended outcome. You also contribute to the wider CoreWeave community, for example by mentoring others.</li> <li>You win buy-in from critical stakeholders on your recommendations, define clear communication strategies tailored to the audience, from engineers to executives, and seek out feedback to improve how you work.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience running compliance programs across several countries, especially in Asia-Pacific or the Middle East.</li> <li>Experience with data residency, sovereign cloud, or in-country hosting requirements for cloud or data center services.</li> <li>Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP.</li> <li>Experience with GRC platforms and with Jira-based program tracking.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds, even if you don't check every box. Here are a few qualities we've found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You're comfortable balancing compliance rigor with practical, scalable solutions.</li> <li>You take ownership, bring structure to ambiguity, and follow issues through to resolution.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and build strong cross-functional partnerships.</li> <li>You're energized by building processes and systems that improve how teams work.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms &amp; Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information. &nbsp;To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. &nbsp;CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications&nbsp;</em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. (“Controller”), which is located at</em></p> <p><em>Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA</em></p> <p><em>and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. You may request a copy of the suitable mechanisms we have in place by contacting us at </em><a ---------- <p><em>Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Where permitted by applicable law, we may also retain your personal data for a limited period after the recruitment process ends in order to consider you for future job opportunities, respond to legal claims, or comply with record-keeping obligations. Under the GDPR and the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. In addition, you may lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority: (i) A list of Europe’s data protection authorities can be found </em><a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://ec.europa.eu/justice/article-29/structure/data-protection-authorities/index_en.htm__;!!I6uDfDBXfA!zaqvpaXitCAqve4cpmPGknjMlTsgIw8w_6xTVeiRpNP5Eo6Ajz9ZkXAYM2uL-nlD8kD6Ndd-Oe-k_BEQQh9xVQGfFw$"><em>here</em></a><em>; and (ii) for the UK, this is the </em><a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://ico.org.uk/__;!!I6uDfDBXfA!zaqvpaXitCAqve4cpmPGknjMlTsgIw8w_6xTVeiRpNP5Eo6Ajz9ZkXAYM2uL-nlD8kD6Ndd-Oe-k_BEQQh9IDhJOUA$"><em>Information Commissioner's Office</em></a><em>.</em><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>For additional information, please see our </em><a href="https://docs.coreweave.com/docs/policies/terms-of-service/privacy-policy"><em>Privacy Policy</em></a><em>.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Release Manager - AI Models
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Our engineering teams bring together ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to turn breakthrough autonomous-driving technology into reliable products. Model releases connect these disciplines, taking AI models from early hypotheses through training, evaluation, and on-road testing to deployment across our vehicle fleet. As our Release Manager — AI Models, you’ll help ensure that a core part of our technology — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production. You’ll bring structure and disciplined release practices to the fast-paced, non-deterministic world of ML, building the processes and systems that support clarity, stability, and business goals. 🧠 Your day-to-day Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence while adapting to changing business priorities. Coordinate across ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to keep releases moving and resolve dependencies. Run the gates that promote models from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment, making clear what is ready to ship and what needs more work. Drive investigations into regressions and integration issues, coordinate rollback or roll-forward decisions, and follow through on technical debt and corrective actions. Be the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, giving engineers and leadership the right level of detail. Run post-release reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements across teams. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Release gates and promotion criteria: Define and justify what it takes for a model to progress, balancing performance gains, reproducibility, product requirements, safety, and compatibility with the onboard software stack and vehicle platform. A release process that works for ML: Build frameworks that connect model development, evaluation, the Wayve onboard stack, and product needs — applying strong release-engineering practices while recognising where hypothesis-driven, non-deterministic systems need a different approach. Bottleneck identification and improvement: Find constraints in the release lifecycle, implement dashboards and KPIs to make them visible, and proactively escalate gaps. Tooling and automation: Partner with ML platform and integration teams to shape end-to-end automated release tooling. Define requirements that improve developer experience, release efficiency, and stakeholder communication. raw.title: Release Manager - AI Models
raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Our engineering teams bring together ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to turn breakthrough autonomous-driving technology into reliable products. Model releases connect these disciplines, taking AI models from early hypotheses through training, evaluation, and on-road testing to deployment across our vehicle fleet.

As our Release Manager — AI Models, you’ll help ensure that a core part of our technology — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production. You’ll bring structure and disciplined release practices to the fast-paced, non-deterministic world of ML, building the processes and systems that support clarity, stability, and business goals.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence while adapting to changing business priorities.

  • Coordinate across ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to keep releases moving and resolve dependencies.

  • Run the gates that promote models from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment, making clear what is ready to ship and what needs more work.

  • Drive investigations into regressions and integration issues, coordinate rollback or roll-forward decisions, and follow through on technical debt and corrective actions.

  • Be the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, giving engineers and leadership the right level of detail.

  • Run post-release reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements across teams.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Release gates and promotion criteria: Define and justify what it takes for a model to progress, balancing performance gains, reproducibility, product requirements, safety, and compatibility with the onboard software stack and vehicle platform.

  • A release process that works for ML: Build frameworks that connect model development, evaluation, the Wayve onboard stack, and product needs — applying strong release-engineering practices while recognising where hypothesis-driven, non-deterministic systems need a different approach.

  • Bottleneck identification and improvement: Find constraints in the release lifecycle, implement dashboards and KPIs to make them visible, and proactively escalate gaps.

  • Tooling and automation: Partner with ML platform and integration teams to shape end-to-end automated release tooling. Define requirements that improve developer experience, release efficiency, and stakeholder communication.

  • Reliable, stable deployments: Strengthen how teams handle model versions, integration issues, regressions, and recovery so that releases deliver value reliably.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in release management, software engineering, or a related field.

  • You understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and release management practices, including testing strategy, system integration, branching, and versioning.

  • You have a conceptual understanding of ML fundamentals: what training data is, the difference between training and inference, what a model version or checkpoint represents, and why model validation is probabilistic rather than simply pass/fail.

  • You have experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools such as GitHub, Buildkite, and CLI tools.

  • You’re skilled at managing releases in complex, fast-moving systems and comfortable adapting processes and tooling as requirements, architecture, and timelines change.

  • You bring strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including when release trade-offs depend on limited or ambiguous data.

  • You communicate clearly with engineers and leadership, helping people understand priorities, risks, and decisions.

  • You’re pragmatic, methodical, and system-minded. You bring strong release-engineering instincts and are keen to develop the judgment to know where ML systems require a different approach.

It’s a bonus if you also bring:

  • Experience in AI/ML, autonomous vehicles, or robotics.

  • Familiarity with MLOps methodologies and tooling.

  • Experience with ML evaluation practices and tooling, especially for physical systems — including simulation, model leaderboards, and statistically powered experiments such as A/B or shadow-mode testing.

  • Awareness of model hardware and software dependencies.

  • A BSc or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand-coded rules or pre-mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once-in-a-generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human-driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real-world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Release Management & Cross Functional Collaboration)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Technical Assessment and Case Study)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

  • 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

  • ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

  • ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands-on in vehicle workshops and labs

  • 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

  • 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

You'll own data correctness across Talos. You'll lead the data quality engineering team, run BAU data operations, and own reference and security master data, along with the pipelines and platform that deliver it.

Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does.

You'll join a small team with the mandate to work independently from product engineering and challenge it. Engineering teams make assumptions about how their systems behave. Your job is to test those assumptions and prove or disprove them with evidence.

 

Responsibilities

  • Lead AI-first data quality engineering

  • Validate every client-facing endpoint continuously. The focus is our REST and WebSocket APIs. Cloud delivery (S3, Snowflake, Databricks) is also in scope. Assert correctness against independent sources of truth, across every environment and client entitlement.

  • Cover streaming as well as request/response. For WebSocket, that means:

  • sequencing and gap detection

  • snapshot-to-increment consistency

  • reconnect and replay correctness

  • staleness of live subscriptions

  • agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state

  • Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts.

  • Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool.

  • Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests.

  • When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier.

  • Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client rate and false-positive rate.

  • Run data governance

  • Build and maintain a catalog of our data assets and APIs, covering lineage and downstream consumers. Maintain an understanding of assets, how they're used and what breaks when they change.

  • Own data governance tooling such as OpenMetadata.

  • Own reference and security master data

  • Lead the build-out of the next-generation security master platform, then run it day to day: new listings, symbol mapping across venues, and increment and contract specs.

  • Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback.

  • Expand coverage across the firm

  • Over time, extend data quality coverage beyond client APIs to:

  • trade signals

  • pre-trade analytics

  • client post-trade analysis

  • PMS analytics

Qualifications

  • A track record of leading data QA or data quality teams, preferably on market data or other high-throughput, real-time data.

  • A deep understanding of streaming and API behaviour: throughput, WebSocket semantics, ordering, recovery and failure modes.

  • Experience inventorying and testing a large API and data surface end to end.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance: cataloging, lineage, ownership.

  • Experience with performance and load testing of distributed systems.

  • A strong engineering background. You design platforms, not scripts on a cron job, and you build on shared infrastructure rather than creating one-off tooling.

  • Practical experience applying LLM and agentic tooling to engineering problems.

  • Our stack: Flink, Doris, Dagster and Spark, plus OpenMetadata (or an equivalent such as Apache Atlas). Experience with comparable tools is just as relevant.

In this fast-paced environment, the design to launch cycle is measured in weeks and months, not years! 

 

What You'll Do as a Senior Firmware Engineer:

  • Design, implement and test, deploy and maintain embedded firmware
  • Collaborate with other engineering functions on scoping, architecture and system design
  • Resolve on-orbit and on-ground issues related to embedded systems
  • Implement, optimize and maintain various serial protocols
  • Design and develop interface tools to improve abstraction between the embedded system and other satellite components
  • Debug and resolve complex embedded systems issues in a timely manner
  • Write and maintain technical documentation

 

Key Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • Mastery of Embedded C programming language
  • Proficiency with scripting languages like Python and Bash
  • Extensive experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), specifically FreeRTOS
  • Familiarity with serial protocols and implementations
  • Strong problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging embedded systems
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Experience developing on Linux (Ubuntu)
  • A base level of mathematical knowledge (engineering mathematic or similar)
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

 

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with space systems or satellite technology
  • Familiarity working to coding standards and using static analysis tools
  • Experience writing Rust for resource constrained environments (embedded Linux)
  • Experience with embedded Linux
  • Knowledge of control systems and algorithms

 

Tools and Technologies:

  • FreeRTOS for real-time operating system implementation
  • GNU ARM Embedded Toolchain for code compilation
  • GDB for debugging, complemented by extensive use of serial and/or CAN debugging
  • Experience with debugging techniques for systems without JTAG access, particularly for remote issue resolution
  • Familiarity with manual testing procedures for embedded interface code
  • Experience working with Arm Cortex Microcontrollers
  • Version control using Git

description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role Every product launch, promo and market entry at LemFi reaches customers through a campaign. As Senior CRM Executive, you'll build and ship them: email, push, in-app and SMS, across remittance, credit, savings and whatever we launch next. You take a brief and turn it into a live, tested, correctly targeted send - then tell us what it did. You'll report to the Senior CRM Manager for Campaigns and work daily with Growth Managers, Product Marketing, Design and Compliance. This is a hands-on role with a high volume of sends and a high bar for getting each one right, because a wrong rate, a broken link or the wrong segment lands in a customer's pocket. Do it well and you'll be the person the rest of the business trusts to get their message out. What you'll build and own Build and launch campaigns end to end in our marketing automation platform: segments, content, scheduling and send. Turn campaign requests from across the business into clear builds, and push back when a brief doesn't hold up. QA every send before it goes: targeting, personalisation, links, localisation and compliance sign-off. Run A/B tests on subject lines, timing, offers and channels, and feed what wins into the next campaign. Keep the campaign calendar honest so customers aren't hit by five messages in one day. Report on every campaign in numbers the team can act on: who received it, who converted, what it was worth. Spot what's repetitive in your own work and template or automate it. Your experience 1-3 years in CRM, email marketing or lifecycle, ideally in fintech, e-commerce or another high-frequency consumer product. Hands-on with a marketing automation platform ( Customer.io , Braze, Iterable or similar) - you build the campaign yourself. Working knowledge of Liquid and HTML for personalised, dynamic content. An eye for detail that catches the wrong segment or the broken link before the customer does. Comfortable pulling your own numbers, with basic SQL or a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker, Amplitude or Mixpanel. Bias to ship: you'd rather launch, measure and iterate than polish a brief. Comfortable using AI tools to speed up copy variants, translations and QA checks. Nice to have Lived experience or deep empathy with the life of our users - the millions who move countries to build something better. Language skills in Italian, Portuguese, German, Mandarin, Wolof or Swahili. Experience running campaigns in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment. Why Join LemFi? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play . Recruitment Agencies Notice LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee. raw.title: Marketing Operations Manager
raw.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to join our Marketing Operations, RevOps team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the operational infrastructure needed to support our upmarket expansion into Mid-Market and Enterprise segments and be part of our Marketing Ops team as we scale our spend management platform across growth companies in Europe. If you're excited about designing account-based go-to-market systems, establishing AI enablement across operational workflows, and solving complex cross-functional challenges, and are passionate about marketing operations, RevOps, and systems architecture, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Associate Director, Marketing Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing Operations, RevOps, and Sales Ops. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to powering how the marketing team runs—from campaign operations and reporting cadence through to AI adoption and process improvement. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data, BAT (Business Automation & Tools), CX Ops, and Engineering to ensure success and maintain a single account truth across systems.

What you’ll be doing

As a Marketing Operations Manager, you will:

  • Build and refine marketing operational frameworks – Lead initiatives to continuously improve campaign workflows, request intake, approval processes, team governance, MQL→MQA routing logic, and SDR/BDR handoff processes.

  • Own account intelligence and reporting cadence – Design account scoring models for Mid-Market and Enterprise, maintain executive dashboards, integrate intent/firmographic/behavioral signals into segmentation, and manage account assignment logic.

  • Drive AI adoption across Marketing Ops – Translate AI capabilities into operational reality by building processes, governance, and enablement that accelerate execution and scale output within the team.

  • Ensure tooling health and systems ownership – Manage HubSpot workflows, automations, and integrations while coordinating with BAT and Engineering on tech stack builds, QA standards, and enterprise tooling requirements.

  • Enable team capabilities and documentation habits – Upskill Marketing and Marketing Ops teammates through shared standards, QA checklists, repeatable guides, templates, and onboarding resources to raise the operational floor.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • HubSpot Fluency – A solid understanding of designing workflows, routing logic, and automation in HubSpot, including its limitations and when to extend outside the platform.

  • Account Operations Mindset – Track record of building ABM operational processes, MQL-to-MQA scoring rules, multi-stakeholder buying committee motions, and AI/automation adoption that sticks.

  • Sales Ops Partnership – Ability to collaborate seamlessly with Sales Ops on account strategy, territory strategy, handoff logic, and rep productivity without jargon.

  • Data & Documentation Habits – Excellent habits in building auditable specs, validating data quality, and diagnosing root causes in data flows alongside Data and BAT teams.

  • Experience with multi-touch attribution modeling, lifecycle marketing operations (nurture flows, recycling, engagement scoring), and ABM platforms / account intelligence tools.

  • A background in seeing a company move upmarket to Mid-Market/Enterprise and building scalable, long-term GTM operations.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are an operational thinker who naturally designs sustainable systems, governance, and frameworks rather than executing quick-fix tasks.

  • You love working cross-functionally across Marketing, Sales Ops, and Data teams to streamline GTM processes and remove friction.

  • You are energized by driving practical AI adoption and upskilling team members through documentation, templates, and shared standards.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer operating in established, rigid systems rather than designing new account-based infrastructure in ambiguous environments.

  • You look at marketing operations as purely executing inbound lead lists without considering account context or buying committees.

  • You rely on tribal knowledge rather than maintaining clear, auditable documentation and QA standards for your builds.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the launch of our account segmentation model to directly power SDR assignments and Mid-Market/Enterprise routing.

  • Collaborate with Data and Marketing Ops teams to clean up attribution, reporting, and lifecycle data so performance metrics are fully trusted.

  • Grow your skills in AI enablement, enterprise GTM systems, and cross-functional RevOps alignment, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in advanced RevOps and enterprise go-to-market strategies.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins chat with the hiring manager, to deep dive in your experience and role

  3. Pleo Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Braze leads, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> is in the running, and we want your view. HubSpot until we switch it off.</li> <li><strong>Revenue systems &amp; data:</strong> Salesforce (system of record), BigQuery, Looker</li> <li><strong>AI &amp; delivery:</strong> Claude Code (skills, connectors), Notion, Linear</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>🧩 About you</h3> <p><strong>To succeed in this job</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in lifecycle, CRM or marketing automation, across both B2B and B2C. On the B2B side, you have run programmes hand in hand with Sales or Account Management on large portfolios (1,000+ accounts). On the B2C side, you have built consumer activation and engagement journeys at scale.</li> <li>A campaign manager first: you turn a business goal into a segment, a timing and a message, and you can show the revenue impact of your past programmes.</li> <li>Hands-on with a modern customer engagement platform: Braze, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a>, Iterable or equivalent. title: Partner Account Manager, Intégrateurs de solutions de gestion
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Localisation et déplacements Poste basé à Paris , selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager. Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ? Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant. Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action : Développer les comptes partenaires , en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell , en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence , grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant , en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain , en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur. Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes. Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes. Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles. Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu. 2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire. Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable. Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane. Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés. Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion. 3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires. Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe. Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau. Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation. Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats. 4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes. Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités. Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs. Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux. Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire. 5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales. Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires. Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat. Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage. Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence. 6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées. Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales. Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires. Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective. Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires. Profil recherché : Compétences incontournables : Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs; Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes; Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles; Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes; Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit; Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée; Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps; Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM; Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations; Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais. Atouts appréciés Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME; Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B. Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients; Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell. Ce que nous recherchons surtout : Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui : Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain; Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables; Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien; Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe; A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques. Process de recrutement : Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane. 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: -Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) -Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant -Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes -Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères. Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- . Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement ." Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager.

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Solution Consulting team led by Jonathan D'Elissagaray, Director of Solution Consulting. The team consists of two Solution Consultants focused on Mirakl Connect, working alongside four Platform Consultants covering B2B customers across Southern Europe and the Middle East. Together, you'll be helping sellers successfully onboard and grow through the Mirakl Connect ecosystem.
 
About Mirakl Connect
Mirakl Connect is Mirakl's ecosystem platform, connecting marketplace operators and sellers to simplify partnerships, onboarding, and growth. Trusted by leading brands such as Macy's and Lacoste, Mirakl Connect helps sellers discover new marketplace opportunities while enabling marketplace teams to efficiently onboard and manage their seller ecosystem at scale.

 Your Impact

  • Guide new Connect customers through end-to-end onboarding — leading sessions, configuring accounts, and troubleshooting blockers in real time to drive fast and effective platform activation.
  • Equip Mirakl Platform clients to independently onboard their own sellers by providing training, clear documentation, and scalable enablement resources including webinars and live walkthroughs.
  • Develop deep expertise in Catalog Transformer — Mirakl's AI-based catalogue management product — and support sellers in troubleshooting and optimising their catalogues.
  • Track onboarding progress across your customer portfolio, maintain detailed records, and deliver structured feedback to continuously improve onboarding flows and the overall seller experience.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, and Data Science/AI teams to align on technical setup, surface insights from onboarding, and ensure guidance always reflects the latest platform capabilities.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, customer support, or account management in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven track record of directly onboarding or educating customers on a new solution
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance or a related field; advanced degree is a plus
Skills:
  • Customer onboarding and hands-on enablement
  • Clear communication and presentation, including handling challenging customer interactions
  • Operational rigour: tracking onboarding stages, documentation, and performance reporting
  • Cross-functional collaboration across technical and commercial teams
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong drive to succeed in a high-growth environment

Tools Used

  • Mirakl Connect
  • Salesforce
  • Gong
  • Google Workspace (Sheets, Slides, Drive)
  • Confluence
  • Dust
  • Catalog Transformer

Languages

  • English: Full professional proficiency (required)
  • French: Full professional proficiency (required)
  • Spanish or Italian (a plus)

description: <p>Artefact is an international consulting and engineering company specialising in data and AI, and a European leader in its field. Our headquarters is located in Paris. For the past 10 years, we have focused on designing and deploying artificial intelligence technologies and data-driven solutions.</p> <p>Headquartered in Paris, we are now present in 24 countries across all continents, with 1,700 employees worldwide.</p> <p>Our mission is to help businesses unlock the full potential of AI and data by developing bespoke solutions tailored to their specific business challenges. As pioneers in this domain, we combine technological expertise with operational excellence, working closely with leading players in the market. Our clients span all key sectors of the economy – including industry, retail, luxury, FMCG, healthcare, and finance – and include major international groups.</p> <p>Beyond consulting, we are strongly committed to promoting ethical and accessible AI. We have launched the School of Data to support career transitions into tech roles, and established an AI Research Centre in both Paris and Shanghai.</p> <p>In the context of Artefact’s accelerating growth, we are looking for a B2B Marketing Intern to join our Marketing team starting in <strong>January 2027</strong>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The role :</strong></p> <p>Are you passionate about B2B marketing in the Tech area and want to work in an environment where your impact on business growth is recognised?</p> <p>If this sounds like you, and you’re ready to step-up your career and level of responsibility, then you might just be our next <strong>B2B Marketing Assistant Intern.</strong></p> <p>The Marketing team at Artefact directly contributes to the business by engaging with existing clients and prospects to convert them as leads to generate sales. title: Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D_CDD 36 mois
description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet ANR-DFG 3DFaceBias , qui vise à mesurer, expliquer et réduire les écarts de précision dans la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir de photographies 2D, nous recrutons un Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D au sein de notre département Data Science sur le campus de Brest. Vous piloterez les travaux d’IMT Atlantique sur l’évaluation et la réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D avec pour principales missions : Auditer les biais de la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir d'images 2D. Identifier les sources de biais par une analyse centrée sur les données. Concevoir et évaluer des stratégies centrées sur les données pour atténuer les biais. Contribuer aux activités transverses du projet. Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée ✔️ Vous avez une solide expérience en recherche expérimentale et en méthodes statistiques avancées. Votre expertise inclut la conception d’expériences contrôlées, l’évaluation des incertitudes, la gestion des facteurs de confusion, ainsi que la prévention des fuites d’information (data leakage). ✔️ Maîtrisant Python et un framework comme PyTorch, vous savez modifier, tester et déboguer du code de recherche avec efficacité. Vos compétences couvrent des domaines clés tels que : Vision par ordinateur, reconstruction 3D et géométrie 3D, Modèles statistiques de forme ou informatique médicale, Équité algorithmique, robustesse, généralisation et génération de données synthétiques. ✔️ Vous excellez dans l’évaluation des performances et des biais, via des analyses par sous-groupes, l’interprétation des disparités et un examen rigoureux des limites. Une expérience en reconstruction faciale 3D serait un atout. ✔️ Autonome et proactif·ve, vous formulez des hypothèses pertinentes et hiérarchisez les expériences avec méthode. ✔️ Rigoureux·se, vous garantissez la reproductibilité de vos travaux, une documentation claire et une gestion collaborative du code et des données. ✔️ Ouvert·e au travail en équipe 🇬🇧 À l’aise en anglais scientifique, vous rédigez avec clarté et précision, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. 🎓 Le profil recherché devra être titulaire d’un Doctorat (obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d’embauche) en apprentissage automatique, informatique, statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, informatique appliquée à l’imagerie médicale ou dans un domaine connexe, obtenu avant la prise de poste.
